title: polypodium reptans var. asplenioides
intro: Polypodium reptans var. asplenioides, commonly known as Asplenium asplenioides or Polypodium asplenioides, is a fern species belonging to the Polypodiaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used in medicine for its health benefits, which include treating various ailments such as fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Polypodium reptans var. asplenioides include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
